# FilterBar

```ts
import { FilterBar } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

The bar above a table, below the Action Bar (Figma hellopc.table.filter.bar, node 18225:394). full shows a saved-view picker, one button per common filter, "Advanced filters", and Reset all (optional search, sort, view switcher); compact — the former hellopc.toolbar, for small tables and cards — shows one "Filters" button with a count, sort, search, view switcher, and Reset all. Use it with column-header filters, not instead of them. Keep one search per table: when the bar shows search, leave the Action Bar's end slot empty.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layout` | `'full' \| 'compact'` | `'full'` | full — saved view, one button per filter, Advanced filters, Reset all (optional search / sort / view switcher). compact — one Filters button, sort, search, view switcher, Reset all — for small tables and cards. |
| `savedView` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Saved-view picker — a size="sm" secondary outline Button with a bookmark icon and chevron (Figma showSavedViews). full only; a divider follows it. |
| `filters` | `React.ReactNode` | — | The filters: Filter Menus in full; in compact, one Filter Rule Builder with triggerAppearance="filter" ("Filters" + count). |
| `advancedFilters` | `React.ReactNode` | — | "Advanced filters" — a Filter Rule Builder (scope="advanced"). full only. |
| `search` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Optional search — a size="sm" TextInput, ~240px wide. |
| `sort` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Optional sort control — e.g. a secondary ghost "Sort: Last used" Button. |
| `viewSwitcher` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Optional view switcher — an icon-only size="sm" secondary ContentSwitcher. |
| `onResetAll` | `() => void` | — | Fires when Reset all is pressed. Clear everything the bar controls — filters, rules, and search. Omit to hide Reset all. |
| `resetDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables Reset all — set it while nothing is applied (Figma state=default). |
| `resetLabel` | `string` | `'Reset all'` | Reset button text. |

Also accepts all `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<FilterBar filters={<FilterMenu label="Status" options={statuses} />} onResetAll={resetAll} resetDisabled={!anyApplied} />
<FilterBar savedView={<Button size="sm" intent="secondary" variant="outline">Standard view</Button>} filters={…} />
<FilterBar filters={…} advancedFilters={<FilterRuleBuilder fields={fields} operators={ops} />} />
<FilterBar filters={…} search={<TextInput size="sm" aria-label="Search" />} sort={sortButton} viewSwitcher={viewSwitcher} />
<FilterBar layout="compact" filters={<FilterRuleBuilder triggerAppearance="filter" triggerLabel="Filters" … />} />
<Table actionBar={…} filterBar={<FilterBar … />} header={…}>{rows}</Table>
```

## Design tokens used

`--color-surfaces-container`, `--stroke-100`, `--color-stroke-border`, `--space-100`, `--space-300`

## Accessibility

- The bar is a role="toolbar" with an aria-label (default "Table filters"). Like the Action Bar, it keeps normal Tab order (no roving focus) because it hosts a text field.
- Each filter button announces its state in its name ("OS type: 2 selected") and aria-expanded; the popovers are labelled dialogs that return focus to their button.
- Reset all is a real disabled button while there is nothing to reset, so it is skipped by Tab rather than doing nothing.
- Give the search field an aria-label; give the view switcher one too.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Put the most-used 3–5 filters on the bar; the rest in Advanced filters | Line up every column as a filter button |
| Clear menus, rules, and search on Reset all | Reset only some filters and leave others applied |
| Use compact for small tables and cards | Use full in a card with no room for its filters |
| Keep one search per table | Show search in both the Action Bar and the Filter Bar |
